name: Extremis-level Threat
summary: Once per battle in your Command phase: until your next Command phase, models with Oath of Moment also re-roll the Wound roll (not just the Hit roll) against your Oath of Moment target.

name: Masters of Manoeuvre
summary: Adeptus Astartes units' ranged attacks gain Assault and stay shooting-eligible after falling back; Mounted units also stay charge-eligible after Advancing/Falling Back. Army: Dark Angels only. Outrider Squad gains Battleline.

name: Invocations of Ancient Fury
summary: Adeptus Astartes weapon profiles named with 'Plasma' get +1 Strength. Army can include Dark Angels units only, no other Chapter's Adeptus Astartes units.

name: Black-winged Vigilance
summary: Ravenwing Fly units' ranged attacks gain Ignores Cover. Army can include Dark Angels units only, no other Chapter's Adeptus Astartes units.

name: Close-range Eradication
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault, and get +1 Strength when their attack targets a unit within 12 inches.

name: Skystrike
summary: Land Speeder and Storm Speeder Hailstrike/Hammerstrike/Thunderstrike units count as Speeder; in your first Movement phase, friendly Speeder units can make an ingress move.

name: Dread Catechism
summary: When a Chaplain destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, enemy units within 6in Battle-shock test. Chaplains also worsen Leadership by 1 for enemy units within 6in (aura). Army: Dark Angels only.

name: Psychic Disciplines
summary: Each battle round, pick a Discipline for friendly Astartes Psyker units until round end: Biomancy +2in M; Divination re-roll hit/wound 1s; Pyromancy +1 AP within 12in; Telekinesis -1 S vs ranged; Telepathy ignores BS/WS/hit modifiers.

name: In The Lion's Claws
summary: An enemy unit (non-Monster/Vehicle) falling back within Engagement Range of a Ravenwing unit takes a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if Battle-shocked. A Deathwing charge into that range gets +2 to the Charge roll.

name: Rapid-drop Deployment
summary: At deployment, a battle-size-scaled number of non-Titanic Adeptus Astartes units gain Deep Strike. A unit set up this turn re-rolls a Wound roll of 1; one that disembarked from a Drop Pod this turn also re-rolls a Hit roll of 1.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Grim Resolve
summary: Battle-shocked Adeptus Astartes units still count Objective Control as 1 (not 0). Each Command phase, pick one Adeptus Astartes unit to get +1 Objective Control until your next Command phase. Army: Dark Angels only.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Imperator Unleashed
summary: After a Fly Infantry unit makes an ingress or charge move this turn, its attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Dutiful Tenacity
summary: Attacks stronger than an Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Mounted unit's Toughness get -1 to the Wound roll.
